description: Replace every link on a profile or link page. Pass ids from list_links to keep click history; links you omit are deleted. Order is the order within each section; at most 2 pinned, 50 in all. Links with the same group show together under its name; null removes the group. trackingEnabled:false links are not counted and keep their place.

id.description: Existing link id; keeps its click history.

name: set_links
title: Set links
